name: Product card
summary: A card for one product: a photo, category, name, one-line description, rating, price with the old price struck out, an Add to bag button and a save toggle.
use: in a store or marketplace grid
a11y: Add to bag and save are toggle buttons with aria-pressed; the rating and the old price are read as words ("Rated 4.6 out of 5", "was $198"), and the photo has alt text.

use_when: a featured product or add-on shown on its own, with a quick add and save
avoid_when: several saved items in a grid: use wishlist-grid
the full product page with several photos: use product-gallery
a dish on a menu: use menu-item

parts.name: tag
parts.what: a short badge on the photo, such as 'New in'

parts.name: description
parts.what: one or two lines about the product

parts.name: rating
parts.what: stars, the average and the review count

parts.name: price
parts.what: price, the old price struck out and the saving

parts.name: add
parts.what: Add to bag toggle that turns into Added

empty.how: with no photo, keep the sunken cover box so the card keeps its shape

loading.how: the cover box keeps its shape and a sunken fill while the photo loads lazily

error.how: if adding fails, set Add back to not pressed and show toast-stack with the reason

disabled.how: for a sold-out product, disable Add, change its text to 'Sold out' and style it with the disabled colours

overflow.how: in a narrow card the padding shrinks and Add to bag takes the full width under the price

long_text.how: name and description wrap with no limit; clamp the description to two lines with -webkit-line-clamp to keep cards in a row even

missing_image.how: the Smart UI renderer swaps a photo that fails to load for a block of the same size with its alt text

keyboard: Tab reaches Save to favourites, then Add to bag
Enter or Space toggles the focused button between pressed and not pressed
